title: SpeakIt
text:
Merged and synced.
PR #13 merged into main (162a0c0); the remote feature branch was deleted.
Local main aligned to the merged commit (the micro-player click change is in), so you're off the diverged lineage now — clean on main tracking origin/main.
Rebuilt against merged main and relaunched — the installed app is current and running.

So the micro circle now does left-click = play/pause, right-click = open (right-click again on the expanded player for the options menu). Give it a go whenever; if the click feel needs tuning I'll branch off main again.
